You rest your hand against a wall, but you miss the wall and fall onto a fridge. The fridge contains a red onion and a yellow bell pepper. There's something strange about this being here, but you can't put your finger on it. You scan the room, seeing an oven. You can make out a table. You see a cookbook on the table. It doesn't get more TextWorld than this! You make out a counter. What a coincidence, weren't you just thinking about a counter? The counter is vast. On the counter you see a red hot pepper. I mean, just wow! Isn't TextWorld just the best? You can make out a stove. The stove is conventional. But the thing hasn't got anything on it. You swear loudly.



There is a roasted white onion, a raw red potato, a carrot and a banana on the floor.
